items.title: Public Test Patch Notes for 17/09
items.summary: v0.2.4.30150 Keep in mind this update is for the Public Test Branch. Nothing of this will reach the live version of the game before being tested. Heroic mode and other additions will be available live on September 30! Additions Added Heroic
items.content:
v0.2.4.30150 Keep in mind this update is for the Public Test Branch. Nothing of this will reach the live version of the game before being tested. Heroic mode and other additions will be available live on September 30!

Additions

  • Added Heroic Difficulty to new instances:
    • The Trunk of the Hivetree (and the great Gatsbee)
    • Lady Bee’s Palace
  • Added Infusion System
    • Infusion can be added to your heroic gear. you'll get stronger by having a complete infused set!
    • You can loot Infusion recipes at the end of Heroic Instances
    • To infuse your gear, you have Infusion crucible in the social hubs
      • Navelin
      • Tyrna
      • Ramburg's Entrance
    • Read more about Infusions and their role in Heroic Difficulty in this blog

Modifications

Balancing (Boss)

  • Nepsilon
    • Tweaked totem link knockback to feel less clunky
    • Added more bubbles in the fight
    • Bubbles are slowing instead of stunning
    • Getting hit by Nepsilon's skill add one more stack of "vulnerability" debuff. This effect is stackable
    • Increased totem healing
  • Reblochonk
    • Cheese area sizes increased and now reach max size faster
    • Removed explosion damage when two areas collide (not the projectiles)
    • Reblochonk now targets a random player when casting the cheese area
  • Crabgantua
    • Added visual effects for the bubble cast
    • Decreased bubble damage
    • Decreased movement speed and HP of the add targeting the Skeleton Shard
    • Bubbles slow instead of stunning
    • Increased delay between two charges
    • Increased time before rocks fall
  • Rastar
    • Decreased adds’ damage and HP
    • Decreased fire DOT damage and reduced its duration
    • Decreased AOE range when Ratsar spins on a fire area

Changes (Weapons)

  • Judgement
    • Passive reworked
      • Rank 1 - After applying a Stun, even if the target is immune, your next Weapon Skill will critically strike with 10% increased damage
      • Rank 2 - Bonus increased to 15%
      • Rank 3 - You permanently deal 25% increased damage to enemies affected by Stun
    • Brutal Frenzy Rank 3 - Has 25% chance to deal additional Physical damage
  • Iron Fins of the Leviathan
    • Groundswell Strike - Damage increased
    • Abyssal Fury - Damage Increased
    • Cascade's thrown axes - damage increased

Other Changes

  • Spark Cube - Now store 20% of the damages you deal to each enemy. After 20s all the damage stored is dealt to the enemies.
  • Infusions - The Infusion Bonus applied to secondary Attribute has been increased
  • Increased power of Epic Gears and Legendary Weapons
  • Increased size of player Social Panel (F)
  • Dummy in social hubs now have the same amount of Armor and Magic Armor than bosses

Bugfixes

  • Spark Cube - Fixed damage being able to be critical or affected by other stats
  • Revive - Fixed cooldown reset when reviving
  • Rogue - Fixed Issues with Shadow Step not making you avoid a hit
  • Crabgantua
    • Fixed an issue where the summoned crab targeting the Shell Shard could fail to spawn at the furthest point
    • Fixed an issue where players near the edge of the Shell Shard were killed by the big wave
    • Fixed issue with rocks falling on the Shell Shard
    • Fixed Waves being avoidable by using geyser only
  • Fervor - Fixed a bug preventing fervor and other modifiers to increase damages of dots (Damage over time)
See YOU in the Public test Farseekers! https://store.steampowered.com/app/3672400/Farever/

items.title: Call to Glory Devlog- Heroic Mode and its rewards
items.summary: The Heroic Mode combines the maximum level of Veteran Mode (previously Hard Mode), as well as introducing new mechanics and patterns that you will need to learn and master. Attacks may behave differently, new dangers appear during the fight
items.content:
The Heroic Mode combines the maximum level of Veteran Mode (previously Hard Mode), as well as introducing new mechanics and patterns that you will need to learn and master. Attacks may behave differently, new dangers appear during the fight and certain bosses have additional phases, completely changing the encounter and how you need to approach it! You can try to triumph unprepared. However, it is advised to get prepared with consumables, good gear, and a brand new item, the Spark Cube. All of this can be crucial in a high-intensity fight on the new difficulty. We designed Heroic Mode not only as a more difficult challenge in the dungeon, but also in response to the strategies you need to adopt to defeat the bosses in their original forms. See it as them learning from your previous run of those past months! Let’s take Crabgantua, the second boss of our game, as an exemple. He has a fairly simple yet deadly attack pattern. You just have to dodge his powerful attacks and inflict enough damage to obtain the fragment shells necessary to survive his deadly “wave”. This can be difficult when you’re starting out, but by the time you reach the maximum level, it should be no secret for you. In Heroic Mode, this fight also has two important additions:
  • Crabgantua can cast bubbles that roam around the arena and slow you. Making you more vulnerable to his attacks
  • A summoned crab will appear during the fight with the sole purpose of destroying fragment shells. Will you be able to get rid of him while distracting the boss?
  • Arena alteration like falling rocks that can deal a lot of damage on impact. Better be careful where you step foot.
This is just one example of the revamped challenges you’ll have to face. If you think you can manage it, we’d like to see you try! Crabgantua is currently available in Heroic Mode on our public test branch alongside Nepsilon, Ratsar and Reblochonk!

Epic Rewards for a Heroic difficulty

Overcoming a Heroic instance will reward you with unique items that can only be obtained there. These are Medals of Glory (MoGs) and Epic Gear. Medals of Glory are a new type of reward associated with Heroic Mode. They can be exchanged for unique, high-level rewards. These include endgame gear, collectibles, and other rewards destined for players taking on the most difficult challenges in our game yet. You will receive additional medals depending on if it is your first time completing the dungeon, if you are in a group, and so on. Epic Gear is a new tier of equipment that is stronger than the current available ones and that can be earned at the end of an instance set in Heroic Mode. Not only do they provide better stats, but you can also infuse them to make them even stronger The new Epic Gear you'll be able to get Infusions are new bonuses that apply when infused to your epic gear. Stack the same infusion bonus across your items to activate exclusive set bonuses with powerful gameplay effects. Here's an exemple:
  • “Life-giving Spring” :
    • 2 pieces of gear infused: Skills grant a stack of tide, healing you for percentage of your max health
    • 4 pieces of gear infused: ~+2.5% Fervor
    • 6 pieces of gear infused: At 5 tides stack, you gain a 25% max health shield. When it expires, it explodes and deals that amount to nearby enemies and heal nearby allies for that amount (30s cd)
Your epic gear also has an “infusion bonus”, which increases its secondary attributes. Make sure the faction-themed infusion you’ll use matches the one of your gear. You can find prismatic bonuses that work with any faction-themed infusion, but they will be hard to get. Infusions can be done at an infusing table by using Medals of Glory. These are just the only direct rewards you can get from the instance. You can also gain unique mounts and collectibles by completing Achievements in Heroic Dungeons under certain conditions. There are plenty of opportunities to prove your skills and master the heroic dungeons!We hope you enjoyed this Heroic Mode preview! Remember that all of this is currently being tested in the Public Test Branch and may change depending on your feedback. If you would like to try out the Heroic Dungeons, simply follow the guidelines in this blog post. Thank you for playing Farever and see you on September 30th Farseekers ✨ - Farever Teamhttps://store.steampowered.com/app/3672400/Farever/

items.title: Call to Glory Major Update #2 - Available September 30th
items.summary: Answer the call and claim victory in our next Major Update to be released on September 30th. The Call to Glory Update introduce the Heroic Mode, a new difficulty level that will be available for all dungeons. Triumph over these dungeons to
items.content:
Answer the call and claim victory in our next Major Update to be released on September 30th. The Call to Glory Update introduce the Heroic Mode, a new difficulty level that will be available for all dungeons. Triumph over these dungeons to obtain new epic gear and reach a new level of power to show off to your friends!

Heroic mode is a new difficulty level for dungeons and bosses that is above the current Normal and Veteran modes. Face off against bosses with new attack patterns, increased health and unexpected twists. Defeat them to gain unique Epic Gear and reach new heights. Fight in Heroic Dungeons to earn Medals of Glory, which you can use to get exclusive rewards! This update includes many long-awaited features, including emotes, a friend list, the ability to revive teammates in fights and improved group rewards.

Public Test available

You can already try out Heroic Mode and all the other changes in our dedicated Public Test Branch! Four dungeons are currently available in Heroic mode, with more to be added:
  • Nepsilon, of the Lost City of Maïda
  • Crabgantua
  • Reblochonk, of the Mine Estrone
  • Ratsar
Feel free to jump in and put your strength to the test. We have opened specific feedback forums on Discord and Steam, as well as a megathread on Reddit. We have also added some other features that you might want to try. You can find the complete list below. v0.2.4-publictest Our goal for this Major Update is to add more system and activity for the endgame loop to answer the need for replayable content. Our main addition for that is the Heroic Mode but also some more options to create more possible interaction with players around you!

Heroic Mode

Dev’s intention: Heroic Mode is made to create a harder challenge than what the current gameplay can provide. While the enemies are still scaling up depending on the number of players. The difficulty has been enhanced to make it so only the most prepared players can win that fight. Heroic Mode Dungeons currently available:
  • Lost City of Mayda
  • Crabgantua’s Gorge
  • Mine Estrone
  • Ratsar’s Lair

Other Features

Additions

  • Added the Spark Cube, temporarily available at the guild merchant
    • Gain Spark Surge which stores 50% of the damage you dealt to each enemy. After 20s all the damage stored is dalt to the enemies. An essential item for Heroic Difficulty
    • Once used, you can refill it at the Obelisk's waters.
  • Added Compass
  • Added Pin for activities on the map
    • Pin can be only for you or visible for your entire team
  • Improved Chat channels
  • Group resurrect in boss fight
  • See your group allies through walls!

Incoming Features

New features will be added to the Public Test every week. Here are some of the additions you can expect:
  • More Dungeons and Bosses in Heroic Mode
  • Medals of Glory merchant
  • Specific Heroic Achievements
    • Can only be unlocked in HM by following specific guidelines during the fight
  • Infusions system with exclusive faction-themed bonuses
  • Reputation system
  • Emotes list
  • Performance improvements
To access the Preview:
  • Right-click on Farever in your Steam Library
  • Select Properties → Betas
  • Choose the “Public Beta Branch”
You can stream the content of the public Test Branch so feel free to share it on your channel! Thank you for playing our game, whether you follow along in the public test or wait for the official release. We can’t wait to see you test your might in Heroic Mode! See you there Farseekers ✨ - Farever Team https://store.steampowered.com/app/3672400/Farever/

items.title: Farever, Online Fantasy ARPG, Upgrades Endgame with Major Update on Sept. 30
items.summary: Online multiplayer action RPG set to receive a hefty update on September 30th.
items.content:
BORDEAUX, France – Sept. 10, 2026 – Farever , the online multiplayer action RPG set in a vast fantasy open world from developer Shiro Games , gears up for a second major update on Wednesday, Sept. 30, enhancing endgame content, multiplayer experience, and improved quality of life for all.

Hone your strongest steel and brave Heroic Mode, a new instance difficulty option introducing tougher enemies to existing dungeons and altered boss mechanics. Overcoming Heroic Mode provides better loot and rewards, dedicated achievements for completionists, and Medals of Glory, a new currency for exclusive rewards.

Endgame-ready players can challenge themselves with Heroic Mode, loot new and powerful Epic-tier gear, infuse their gear with faction-themed bonuses to further expand build variety and combat options.

In addition to Heroic Mode and new gear options, the update also adds a wealth of new social and quality-of-life changes, such as:

“Farever’s next content update is focused on enhancing the endgame experience and bolstering social interactions,” said Quentin Lapeyre, Game Director. “We hope that players are excited to tackle Heroic Mode and earn powerful new gear when the update launches on September 30.”

Farever is available now in Early Access on PC via Steam for $19.99 and English, French, German, Spanish, Polish, Russian, Brazilian Portuguese, Japanese, Korean, and Simplified Chinese language support. For more information, follow Farever on X (formerly Twitter) , Facebook , and Instagram , and follow Shiro Games on Bluesky .

Shiro Games is an independent Bordeaux-based studio founded by video game veterans Sebastien Vidal and Nicolas Cannasse to bring new innovative games to life. Its popular Viking strategy game Northgard released on Steam in 2018, and sold more than five million units. Wartales, its tactical RPG set in an alternate medieval world, has sold more than a million units since its release in April 2023.

Shiro Games released two titles into early access in 2026 after each game acquired hundreds of thousands of wishlists, the online multiplayer action RPG set in a vast fantasy open world Farever, and the space exploration and building game SpaceCraft. Shiro Games has two unreleased titles in production, its ruthless survival FPS and top 100 wishlisted unreleased game Frostrail, and its city-building auto-battler Northgard Battlegrounds being developed by Funday Games.

For more information, please visit the official website or our LinkedIn .

Veronica Stodolnik | Ray Porreca | Ian Boudreau

veronica@stridepr.com | raymond@stridepr.com | ian@stridepr.com

items.title: Introducing Farever Creator Program✨
items.summary: Hello everyone! We’re excited to introduce the Farever Creator Program, a space dedicated to supporting creators who make content around Farever Whether you stream, create videos, share short-form content, or make fan art, the program is de
items.content:
Hello everyone! We’re excited to introduce the Farever Creator Program, a space dedicated to supporting creators who make content around Farever Whether you stream, create videos, share short-form content, or make fan art, the program is designed to give you more tools, visibility, and opportunities to collaborate with us.

What's included?

As a member of the Farever Creator Program, you'll get access to:
  • Creator asset packs to help improve your overlays, thumbnails, and other content (With screenshots, font, and key art)
  • Tips and insights directly from the development team
  • A dedicated Content Creator role on the official Farever Discord
  • Opportunities to have your work featured in:
    • Our Monthly Community Blog
    • Farever’s official social media channels
  • Direct access to creator-specific resources and discussions
  • Potential opportunities to collaborate directly with the development team around upcoming updates and content

How do I join?

To apply to the Farever Creator Program, you must:
  • Be 18 years old or older
  • Create content in one of the languages currently supported by Farever. You can find the full list on our Steam page
  • Be able to communicate with us in English or French
We also ask applicants to meet at least one of the following activity requirements:
  • Twitch: At least 25 average concurrent viewers over the past 90 days
  • YouTube: At least 500 average views over the past 90 days
  • TikTok: At least 500 average views over the past 30 days, with a minimum of 3 videos published during that period
  • Instagram: At least 500 average views over the past 30 days, with a minimum of 3 Reels published during that period
  • Artists: Have created and shared art or fan art within the past 90 days. There’s no follower or view requirement here, we’ll simply take a look at your work!
Meeting these requirements does not automatically guarantee acceptance into the program. Applications may be reviewed individually to make sure the program remains relevant and useful for everyone involved. If you think you’re a good fit for it, you can join using the link below Join the Creator Program We'll begin the acceptation process next week!

FAQ

What is the Creator program? It’s a space where content creators can find additional assets and tips to help them make their content Can I apply? Any creator who meets the eligibility criteria and/or is passionate about Farever can apply. Whether you’re a streamer, videomaker or an artist, we’d love to hear from you! Keep in mind meeting these requirements does not automatically guarantee acceptance into the program Will you share keys for giveaway? This program does not give access to game keys. Those will be shared at our own discretion. Can I still post about the game? Obviously you can! We also keep the content creation channels on the Official Discord for everyone to post into, that way if you’re just starting you can still share your gameplay with the rest of the community! Is there anything more to expect? We are just starting this creator program so you can expect a lot of shifts on it with time! Be one of the pioneers and join before those 👀https://store.steampowered.com/app/3672400/Farever/

Demon Huntresses

Balancing

Combat

Robin Hoof

High Inquisitor Chakram

v0.2.1.28382 Hi Farseekers,

Following the release of our latest Major Update, we wanted to quickly address several bugs reported by the community and bring the experience closer to what we intended.

Below, you’ll find a list of fixes now available in Farever.

Bugfix

System

  • Fixed bumpers throwing players too far, preventing access to certain parts of the world.

    [/*]

  • Fixed Chaotic Portal sometimes being allowed to move.

    [/*]

  • Fixed NPCs looting gear and weapons unexpectedly.

    [/*]

items.title: Major Update #1 | The Nightling invasion
items.summary: Take on the Nightlings and the Crimson Rams in the first major content update for Farever. The game is also currently available at 20% off its original price ! This update features new world events, the Rifts, and a new region. This update
items.content:
Take on the Nightlings and the Crimson Rams in the first major content update for Farever. The game is also currently available at 20% off its original price ! This update features new world events, the Rifts, and a new region. This update allows you to level up to 25 and discover new weapons to try out!

New Events - The Rifts

Face the Nightlings in their own realms by taking part in the first of many world events: the Rifts! Every hour, a nightling rift open in Skover or the Valley of the Eternal Autumn. It's up to you to enter the rifts and kicks the nightling before the reach Siagarta. In the rift, a group of a dozen players (you included) can fight against nighlings and nightlords coming from multiple gates. You win by beating those foes and closing said gates until their boss comes in. The more gates you close, the better the reward will be! Depending on how well you did in closing the Nightling gates, you'll have more unique currency that can be used with a new NPC: The Demon Hunter. With that currency, you can buy new unique set of gears, weapons, spark crystals and brand new demonic upgrades

New Region - The City of Ramburg

You now have access to the stronghold of the Crimson Rams: the city of Ramburg. This region hides many secrets that you can uncover by exploring it and facing its master, the High Inquisitor Chakram. In Ramburg, you will find many new activities, as well as two instances: There are the Crimson Barracks and the boss fight against Chakram itself! You can also collect new secret orbs and make new friends while exploring the Crimson Cathedral and the lower city.

And a lot more!

That’s not all! This update comes with:
  • 50+ New collectibles
  • New recipes for all jobs
  • New weapons
    • Martyr of Enripit and the Censer of the Wool Hollow can be claimed in instances
    • New demonic weapons can be obtained at the Demon Hunter against Rift currency
  • A new level cap
    • You can now reach level 25, and the hard mode for dungeons has been adjusted to this level.
  • Quality of Life
    • You can now hide your helmets, as well as any other piece of equipment
    • You now have a "spectator cam" if killed during a boss fight
  • More work on performance
    • A lot of optimization work has been carried out, especially with regard to VFX affecting performance.
If you would like to find out more about all the changes that the update brings, take a look at our changelog below 👇 v0.2.0.28315

Additions

  • Added new world events: The Rifts
  • Added new region: The City of Ramburg
  • New Instances: The Crimson Barracks & The High Inquisitor Chakram
  • Raised level cap to 25
  • Added new unique weapons gained from dungeons and rifts

UI

  • Upgrading weapons now shows the amount of resources the player has
  • Added a notification when collecting a blue orb during a Blue Orb activity
  • New weapon upgrade rank UI

System

  • After wiping on a boss, long-cooldown skills are reset
  • Improved player synchronization (player movement should be less choppy)
  • Spectator mode for dead player in group during dungeon
  • Added “hide item” in the apparence

Performances

  • Improvements have been made when multiple players are playing in the same location
  • Some visual effects from other players have been reduced (improving performance and readability)
  • DLSS has been added; it may improve performance on certain configurations
  • Various optimizations (client & server side)

Bugfixes

Weapons

  • Radiance
    • Fixed Pyroclasm status being applied before dealing damage
  • Horn of the Wind
    • Fixed Ram Trap dealing damage for each foe hit by the skill
    • Fixed Ram Trap rank 3 damage values
    • Fixed Thrill of the Hunter not applying to all enemies when using skills that hit multiple targets
  • Ramulus & Ramus
    • Fixed Ram impulsion knockback behavior
    • Fixed Inner Peace not displaying the amount of shield provided
    • Fixed Inner Peace rank 3 effect triggering at rank 1
    • Fixed Blind Breakthrough damage displayed on the skill tooltip
  • Gorgon Ratsay’s Toothpick
    • Fixed Heart of the Furnace rank 3 not stacking shields
    • Fixed final combo attack sometimes failing to deal damage
    • Fixed Eruption rank 2 cooldown reduction not working
    • Fixed Swirling Embers not triggering Heart of the Furnace
  • Credence
    • Fixed incorrect weapon icon being displayed
    • Ghost Clams of the Low Tide
    • Fixed Tidal Totem healing twice on every trigger
  • Wingsabers
    • Fixed Queen’s Decree failing to increase all damage of multi-hit skills

Classes

  • Warrior
    • Fixed healing of the Last Stand mastery for Ignore Pain
  • Mage
    • High Voltage (mage Chaincast talent) has been reworked to: Consuming chaincast causes your next Final Combo Attack to critically strike.

Boss

  • Golcano
    • Fixed Golcano not being counted as dead when dying from the final explosion
    • Fixed telegraph disappearing during the Eruption skill
    • Fixed VFX during Fire Blast appearing only for the first hit
    • Fixed missing text on the Melting status effect
    • Fixed new golems not spawning if the player does not destroy the shield
    • Fixed the exploding golem before the boss not being able to be sent onto the platform
  • Queen Honeyzabeth
    • Fixed Feeder Bees being able to heal players Fixed Princes and Princesses dropping loot
  • Sponge Blob
    • Added an oxygen spot after killing the boss

System

  • Added security to prevent party disbanding when leaving a dungeon
  • Fixed dead party members not receiving credit for a boss kill
  • Fixed weapons remaining visible during flight
  • Fixed ally characters not leaving the dungeon when they should have
  • Fixed Scrap system incorrectly calculating the inventory space required when scrapping
  • Fixed players occasionally being teleported back to the starting beach

UI

  • Fixed life and shield bars displaying 0% when they were not actually at 0%
  • Fixed ally banners not updating correctly when changing gear while in a party

Items

  • Fixed missing asset/name for “Waist_Z2U2_FigCle” and “Back_Z2U2_AssWiz“

Foes

  • Fixed poison attacks inflicting the status effect on players even after performing a perfect block
  • Fixed slime animations

Achievements

  • Fixed some achievements not triggering

Sound and Effects

  • VFX - Fixed orb chest VFX rotation
  • SFX - Fixed various audio issues

Text

  • Fixed bonus display for certain talents
  • Fixed critter names displayed when capturing one
  • Fixed issues with plural words
  • Fixed Job Trainer text display for Japanese and Chinese
  • Fixed some Japanese text not displaying in the correct font
  • Fixed overlapping text for items

Known Issues

  • Items - Trinket "Finger of Sakuna’Maatata" and "Purified Heart" incorrectly display the damage/healing amounts they grant (but they work)
  • Achievements - Some may not trigger as expected
  • Assets - Some fountains may not be displayed
  • Microsoft - Smart App control is flagging Farever incorrectly. Check on your computer to bypass it.
  • Linux/Steamdeck - Proton version under Proton 10 no longer supported, be sure to update it
  • Missing some localization
Many of you provided valuable feedback during the Playable Preview, which helped to shape the Rifts we see today. Thank you for taking part! We hope you enjoy this new feature and the change of pace it brings to the current game loop. We’ll continue to add more experiences like this alongside new content and performance improvements as we work towards version 1.0. Over the next few weeks, we’ll focus on hotfixes before moving on to our next update and adding more difficulty to the current dungeons. We’re also working on requested features such as better location tools (e.g. a compass) and more social and communication features, which will be added later this year! https://store.steampowered.com/app/3672400/Farever/

items.title: Online Fantasy ARPG Farever’s Nightling Invasion Content Update Launches July 15
items.summary: 'The Nightling Invasion' update coming to online multiplayer action RPG on July 15th.
items.content:
BORDEAUX, France – July 7, 2026 – The first major update for Farever , the online multiplayer action RPG set in a vast fantasy open world from developer Shiro Games , launches Wednesday, July 15, on PC via Steam Early Access. ‘The Nightling Invasion’ introduces all-new mechanics, daunting challenges, and a treacherous area to explore.

The mystical world of Siagarta needs heroes now more than ever. Mysterious portals known as Rifts manifest all across the land, creating pathways to the demon-infested realm of Niflel. Assemble a daring party, don the best gear, then venture into the Rifts to survive increasingly challenging waves of demonic enemies from beyond the veil.

Join groups of up to 15+ players to take on Farever’s new world events and battle minor, major, and primordial terrors. Earn Demonic Souls to exchange for exclusive rewards like exclusive mounts, fearsome weapons, and powerful runes.

Once the trials beyond the rifts have settled, explore Ramburg, home to the forbidding stronghold of the Crimson Rams. Navigate the Lower City, meeting the monks, zealots, soldiers, and inquisitors who reside within.

Dash across rooftops and through secret passageways to unearth the secrets of Ramburg and its terrifying High Inquisitor Chakram, located in the grand Cathedral. Conquer two new dungeons with one of Farever’s four starting classes, and power up to a new level cap of 25.

“The Nightling Invasion is a massive addition to Farever, with a new region, new dungeons, world events, and so much more,” said Quentin Lapeyre, Game Director. “Our team will only continue to expand the magic-infused world of Siagarta, so look forward to even more depth, formidable challenges, and ambitious updates throughout 2026!”

Farever is available now in Early Access on PC via Steam for $19.99 and English, French, German, Spanish, Polish, Russian, Brazilian Portuguese, Japanese, Korean, and Simplified Chinese language support. For more information, follow Farever on X (formerly Twitter) , Facebook , and Instagram , and follow Shiro Games on Bluesky .

Shiro Games is an independent Bordeaux-based studio founded by video game veterans Sebastien Vidal and Nicolas Cannasse to bring new innovative games to life. Its popular Viking strategy game Northgard released on Steam in 2018, and sold more than five million units. Wartales, its tactical RPG set in an alternate medieval world, has sold more than a million units since its release in April 2023.

Shiro Games released two titles into early access in 2026 after each game acquired hundreds of thousands of wishlists, the online multiplayer action RPG set in a vast fantasy open world Farever, and the space exploration and building game SpaceCraft. Shiro Games has two unreleased titles in production, its ruthless survival FPS and top 100 wishlisted unreleased game Frostrail, and its city-building auto-battler Northgard Battlegrounds being developed by Funday Games.

For more information, please visit the official website or our LinkedIn .

items.title: Online Multiplayer Action RPG Farever Now Available in Early Access on Steam
items.summary: Shiro Games' online multiplayer action RPG now available in Early Access.
items.content:
BORDEAUX, France – May 6, 2026 – Farever , the online multiplayer action RPG set in a vast fantasy open world from Dune: Spice Wars , Wartales , and Northgard developer Shiro Games , is now available in Early Access on PC via Steam.

Heed the call of adventure and journey across Siagarta, either solo or with a group of fellow adventurers in online co-op. Explore expansive regions filled with distinct biomes, dangerous enemies, hidden dungeons, and valuable treasures. Traverse the world with complete freedom: climb towering cliffs, glide across valleys and canyons, and dive into underground and underwater caverns. Every corner of this vibrant world rewards exploration with secrets, gear, and evolving content.

Choose from one of four starting classes (with more planned for 1.0), each offering a different approach to combat roles such as damage, support, or survivability. Build your playstyle through a wide range of weapons, abilities, and talents. In Farever, gear plays a central role in progression. Each piece contributes to your build by unlocking new effects, passive bonuses, and synergies, allowing you to experiment and create a combat identity that’s truly your own. Team up with friends to take on powerful enemies and challenging bosses that reward coordination and mastery.

Whether solo or in a group, Farever dynamically scales its activities to match party size, ensuring a balanced and engaging experience for all players. Between expeditions, return to town to craft equipment, upgrade your gear, or gather rare resources to create potions and consumables that will support you and your allies in battle

“Today’s Early Access launch marks the beginning of an exciting new adventure,” said Nicolas Cannasse, CEO of Shiro Games. “We’re proud to build Farever alongside our community and evolve the game throughout Early Access with player feedback. After all, what’s an adventure without adventurers?”

Farever is available now in Early Access on PC via Steam for $19.99 with English, French, German, Spanish, Polish, Russian, Brazilian Portuguese, Japanese, Korean, and Simplified Chinese language support. For more information, follow Farever on X (formerly Twitter) , Facebook , and Instagram , and follow Shiro Games on Bluesky .

Shiro Games is an independent Bordeaux-based studio founded by video game veterans Sebastien Vidal and Nicolas Cannasse to bring new innovative games to life. Based in Bordeaux, France, the studio released its first project Evoland in 2013 and its acclaimed sequel Evoland 2 in 2015. Shiro Games then launched its popular Viking strategy game Northgard on Steam in 2018, which has gone on to sell more than 3 million units across various platforms as well as Dune: Spice Wars, the spice-infused blend of 4X and RTS gameplay. Wartales is their latest title, with several major DLC additions since its release in April 2023.

items.title: Farever Early Access Review
items.summary: Farever Early Access review: A rough start hampered by performance. But there's a solid online action-RPG simmering just beneath the surface.
items.content:
Platform : PC (Steam Early Access) Developer : Shiro Games Publisher : Shiro Games

It’s easy to jump into the world of Farever . If you’ve played a modern-gen Zelda game , or Genshin Impact , or most open world RPGs, you already have a good idea how Farever plays: explore the world, battle monsters, find loot, and grow stronger. And do it all with others!

Farever doesn’t exactly break the genre mold, and the Early Access version is incredibly rough. But there’s a solid online action-RPG simmering just beneath the surface.

Read on for our Early Access Review of Farever !

At Early Access launch, Farever has four classes: Warrior, Mage, Priest, and Rogue. I usually play Rogues or Warriors in my fantasy RPGs, but this time I created a Mage. The class determines class skills, as well as which weapons I can wield. In the case of a mage, I use spellbooks, and my initial spellbook contains fire spells.

Like many RPGs, I begin on a beach, with very little fanfare. The online game knows I’m one of many adventurers; pretty much the opposite of a Chosen One. But I would’ve liked a bit more story context — and especially, an actual tutorial.

Farever does an incredibly poor job explaining its systems. While it’s true that too many games go overboard with hand-holding and tutorializing over their first dozen hours, Farever explains almost nothing. The game presumes I’ve played MMO-style fantasy RPGs before (I have), and simply sets me loose in its large world.

There’s always something interesting to check out

The beach is full of giant crabs, and my initial quest is to simply kill a bunch and turn in some of their claws. The most basic of MMO fetch quests.

Combat is entirely cooldown based. My basic attacks deal quick fire damage, while every third attack charges a more powerful blast. My main skill is a charged fireball. It deals a lot of damage and applies a burning effect, but it’s on a long cooldown. My second attack is much quicker, stunning enemies who are burning.

The strategy becomes simple but effective — begin each battle by launching a fireball. Then use my basic attack alongside the stun blast. Most similarly-leveled enemies die around the time they reach me, which is good because I’m quit squishy!

Boss battles where a whole different matter, however.

I quickly learned not to let this oversize boar hit me too many times

Thankfully I have a dodge, and as a mage I also learn a quick teleport dash, and a protective shield. Every class can also block to reduce damage, and reduce damage even further by timing it perfectly (a system I always appreciate).

items.summary: FAREVER is shaping up to be Shiro Games' latest hit. The online multiplayer action RPG that entered Early Access just a week ago has hit 100,00 units sold on Steam, off the back of its 175,000 wishlists when it was first revealed last year at the PC Gaming Show. It was indeed one of this year's ...
items.content:
Gaming FAREVER Hits 100,000 Units Sold In First Week Of Early Access GameDaily Follow Franz Christian Irorita Fri, May 15, 2026 at 9:45 AM UTC FAREVER Hits 100,000 Units Sold In First Week Of Early Access FAREVER is shaping up to be Shiro Games' latest hit. The online multiplayer action RPG that entered Early Access just a week ago has hit 100,00 units sold on Steam , off the back of its 175,000 wishlists when it was first revealed last year at the PC Gaming Show. It was indeed one of this year's most anticipated games .

FAREVER's online action role-playing game invites players to explore the fantasy world of Siagarta, either alone or with friends. FAREVER sports a colorful, cozy aesthetic that makes it more appealing to a wider audience, and its inviting look is already making it popular among gaming circles.

Not resting on their laurels, Shiro Games is promising continuous fixes and updates throughout the game's Early Access run, releasing its first patch this Wednesday.

"While we were confident that Farever 's world would resonate with adventurers, seeing them flock in droves to the Early Access launch has us even more excited about its future," says Shiro Games CEO Nicolas Cannasse. "Our goal is to create an immersive and enjoyable experience based on player feedback throughout Early Access, and we're committed to frequent updates over the coming months to make Farever event better."

This is necessary for the game's survival, too, as Farever currently sits at a measly 66% Mixed reviews on Steam. The silver lining? Almost 3,000 players left their impressions on the game's Steam reviews, indicating a strong community that really has an investment into this game's eventual success.

Shiro Games' roadmap for Farever includes additional regions, more enemy factions, World Events, increased difficulty modes, a Faction reputation system, an increased level cap, new classes and talent trees, more collection elements, new weapons and weapon skills, and social features such as a Guild System and PvP.
